item.title: Beer I go again on my own!
item.description: Ancient spirits of alcohol. Transform this decayed form… into Beerman! The Ever Drinking! So it’s been a while and there’ve been a few changes around these parts while we were away. First of all, shortly after the thrilling conclusion of Drinktober 2024 that absolute rotter Heidi decided to stop drinking for good. Shocking, right? What kind of a monster puts her own health and wellbeing ahead of my narcissistic need for attention?
